text:
Zara Malik (CS): Quick dump from Aurora Health onboarding call — capturing asks so PM/Product can triage.
Omar Khalid (PM): paste raw bullets pls
Zara Malik (CS): Raw notes: 
- Request: an "audit-lock" (tenant-level deployment freeze) that prevents auto-upgrades during their monthly audit window.
- Request: feature-level cost breakdown (ability to tag requests with feature_name and export CSV grouped by feature and route).
- Request: a tiny cost-forecast widget in Console that projects next-30d spend per-tenant based on recent usage.
- Pain: private deploy tracing — their ingress sometimes strips trace_id making cross-service diagnostics harder.
- Ask: 30-min enablement + a one-page procurement cost justification template.
Lucy Zhang (Eng): Quick tech notes: audit-lock = a routing flag + enforcement at deploy time; backend ~6 dev-days, UI ~3 dev-days if we add RBAC. Feature tagging + CSV = exporter change + small endpoint ~3 dev-days. Forecast widget = prototype ~4 dev-days (backend estimator + small UI). Tracing passthrough likely config for most sidecars but need sample.
Theo Barnes (Product): From call tone: cost CSV + audit-lock are renewal blockers. Forecast widget and enablement collateral are high-impact but secondary.
Omar Khalid (PM): Proposed prioritization: 
- P0: feature-level cost tags + CSV export -> owner: Omar Khalid -> ETA: 10 business days -> reason: finance needs to reconcile internal chargebacks
- P0: tenant audit-lock (freeze toggle + RBAC) -> owner: Theo Barnes -> ETA: 3 weeks -> reason: compliance window for renewal
- P1: trace_id passthrough spec (private deploy) -> owner: Zara Malik -> ETA: 3 business days to spec
- P1: 30-day forecast widget prototype -> owner: Theo Barnes -> ETA: 2 weeks
- P1: enablement workshop & one-pager -> owner: Zara Malik -> ETA: next Tue session
ticket-bot: Created ticket AH-7200: "Aurora Health — feature cost tags & CSV" assigned to Omar Khalid due 10 business days.
Zara Malik (CS): Acceptance criteria for CSV: columns = utc_date, tenant_id, feature_name, route, token_count, cost_cents, currency, notes. Timezone = UTC. Also include header for customer_reference.
Lucy Zhang (Eng): Please upload a one-week sample of traffic and a minimal sidecar config to /customers/aurorahealth/onboard so I can validate header passthrough assumptions.
Omar Khalid (PM): Adding smoke-test prompt set requirement to AH-7200 (8 prompts: short, long, structured, edge-case) and finance CSV schema. I'll draft a short PRD by Fri.
Theo Barnes (Product): Ill mock the audit-lock flow and RBAC options and drop designs into AH-7201 (audit-lock) by EOD Thu.
Zara Malik (CS): Scheduling enablement workshop for Tue 11:00 and uploading call recording + procurement notes to the customer folder.
Lucy Zhang (Eng): Will start scoping the exporter changes tomorrow and post a short runbook with estimated cost impact for warm pools if we consider warm-workers for low-QPS tenants.
Omar Khalid (PM): Thanks all — Ill link tickets to the renewal playbook and update Aurora once PRD lands. :thumbsup:
